slides.text: Imagine you hired the fastest builder in the world. He builds a whole house before lunch. One small problem. He never asks what you wanted.
That builder is Claude. Brilliant. Tireless. And if you ask for a dog house, he might build you a castle. A very nice castle.
Now imagine ninety-nine of him. All building at once. And three of them are standing still, waiting for you to answer a question. You don't know which three.
Steerify is the clipboard on the wall. One board, where every builder writes two things. Here is my question. Here is what I finished.
Let's try it. Say you want a website for your bakery. You type that. In normal words, like you'd say it to a person.
Before he builds anything, Claude asks. Not with a wall of text. With pictures. Do you want it like this, like this, or like this? You point at one.
Then he builds. You go and do something else. Coffee is a valid choice.
When it's ready, you get a picture of the result, and one simple question. Does this look right? If not, you put a finger on the picture and say what's wrong.
When you're happy, you say OK. One button, and it goes live.
And it is not only building. Ask for a report every Monday, and he hands it in, for you to check. Like homework. His homework.
You never read code. You never scroll through a thousand lines of chat. You look. You choose. You say ship.
That's Steerify. You decide. Claude builds. It's free, it's for Mac, and it lives at steerify dot dev.
